# Syed Co.

> Syed Co. is the personal site of Taimoor Syed, an investor, consultant and entrepreneur based in Vancouver, BC. He helps Canadian organizations work out what is holding back their sales and marketing, and who is best placed to fix it. That is sometimes himself and often someone in his network.

## About Taimoor Syed

- 10+ years in sales and marketing: running campaigns, door knocking, cold calling, go-to-market strategy, CPG packaging, and most recently building with AI
- Has worked with 50+ Canadian organizations across agriculture, CPG, restaurants, healthcare, government, associations, software and service-based businesses
- Works with scaling organizations across Canada

## Pages

- [Home](https://syedco.com/): overview, areas of help, experience, and contact form

## Insights

- [Insights index](https://syedco.com/insights/): practical writing on sales, marketing and growth
- [Why your marketing isn’t working (and how to find the real problem)](https://syedco.com/insights/why-your-marketing-isnt-working/): It’s rarely the budget or the platform. Three things to check first when your marketing isn’t delivering, and a simple plan to fix it.
- [Why sales stalled, and where to look first](https://syedco.com/insights/why-sales-stalled/): Before you hire, discount or panic, spend 30 minutes finding where deals are actually falling off. A simple way to diagnose a sales slump.
- [Agency, freelancer, in-house or fractional: how to choose](https://syedco.com/insights/agency-freelancer-in-house-or-fractional/): There’s no best option for marketing or sales help, only the right one for your problem, budget and time. How to choose, what to ask and what to avoid.
- [How to launch a product in Canada](https://syedco.com/insights/how-to-launch-a-product-in-canada/): A launch is not an announcement. A simple three-phase plan for launching a product in Canada that builds demand before launch day and keeps it going after.
